subject: history
concept: Applying ancient civilizations knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student acts as a 'museum curator,' choosing artifacts to represent a studied civilization and explaining their choices
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their chosen museum display
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their chosen artifacts represent the civilization well

assessment.mastery_threshold: artifact choices are accurate and well-explained for the chosen civilization
misconception_flags: chooses an artifact that doesn't actually belong to the studied civilization

interest_binding: civilization/angle generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
